---
name: act-status-reporting
description: Creates concise, evidence-bounded status reports with progress, risks, decisions, and next actions without assuming external-system access.
---

1. State the reporting period, objective, and intended audience. Use only
   information provided or directly observed in the current context.
2. Separate verified completed work, work in progress, blocked work, decisions,
   risks, dependencies, and requested help. Include the impact and owner only
   when known.
3. Distinguish facts from estimates, confidence, and assumptions. Do not imply
   access to calendars, issues, repositories, sessions, metrics, or people that
   has not been established.
4. Close with the next safe action, decision needed, or review date if supplied.
   Make omissions visible rather than filling them with plausible detail.
5. Match the detail and tone to the audience while keeping the report scannable
   and free of unnecessary operational or personal data.
